top_signals.title: FTSE 100 Live: Stocks to slip; US hits back at ‘surprise’ Iran attacks to end pause in conflict
top_signals.summary: Welcome back to the City AM FTSE 100 liveblog. It’s Wednesday and the UK’s blue-chip index is set to fall after the US retaliated against ‘surprise’ Iran strikes overnight. The US launched joint strikes with Saudi Arabia against Tehran-backed militias in Iraq after Washington claimed its forces in the Middle East were targeted by “an attempted surprise [...]
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Korean Stocks Plunge as Much as 13% in Burst of Retail Selling
top_signals.summary: South Korean stocks slumped as retail investors rushed to cut positions, with SK Hynix Inc.’s disappointing earnings worsening the already‑jittery sentiment around artificial intelligence.
